1.name: Requirements and scope
1.description: I clarify the project goals, main user flows, and success metrics, then turn them into a clear feature list and scope.

2.name: UX design and UI direction
2.description: I sketch low-fidelity wireframes for key pages, plan layout and navigation, and decide on basic colors and typography.

3.name: Architecture, data model, and API design
3.description: I design the overall architecture, define the database schema, and plan the API endpoints and payloads.

4.name: Frontend implementation with mock data
4.description: I build the frontend page by page using mock data, making each component responsive and accessible.

5.name: Backend and API implementation
5.description: I implement the backend and REST API according to the plan, including authentication, validation, and core logic.

6.name: Incremental integration
6.description: I connect the frontend to the backend one endpoint at a time to verify each feature works end-to-end.

7.name: Testing and quality assurance
7.description: I test critical user flows, fix bugs, and check behavior across different devices and environments.

8.name: Deployment and maintenance
8.description: I deploy the app to the cloud, set up monitoring and logging, and keep improving and fixing issues over time.
